title: Training Without Fooling Yourself: The Step Size, a Network That Learns the Noise, and Stopping on a Validation Set

artifact.note: training the network of 38-03 on the demonstrations: one step of gradient descent on one sample, an epoch that visits every training sample once in an order shuffled from a seed, the mean squared error of a network on a set (with the training part's scale), and training that keeps the weights with the lowest error on a validation set and stops when that error has not improved for a number of epochs; with the step size too small, right and too large, a network that over-fits a small noisy set, and the network against the straight line on the same split
